KUSHAL GUPTA

SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER | PAYMENTS TRANSFORMATION & MIGRATION | ISO 20022 | SWIFT | CROSS-BORDER PAYMENTS

Mumbai, India | 9833170313 | kushald018@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Project Manager with 18+ years of BFSI experience, including extensive leadership of complex payments transformation, migration and technology delivery programmes across international banking environments.. Currently leading payments initiatives for Lloyds Bank, with experience across European markets. Strong track record in end-to-end project delivery, governance, risk and RAID management, stakeholder engagement, migration, regulatory compliance, UAT and production readiness. Experienced in working across business, technology, compliance, finance, operations, architecture and financial-institution stakeholders.

CORE EXPERTISE

Payments Transformation & Migration • SWIFT / Cross-Border Payments • Project & Programme Delivery • RAID / Risk & Issue Management • Scope / Timeline / Budget & Cost Tracking • UAT / Production Readiness • JIRA / Confluence / MS Project PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

ISO 20022 (PACS / PAIN / CAMT) • SEPA / Instant / Classic / ACH / High Value Payments • Project Governance & Steering Committees • Senior Stakeholder Management • Regulatory & Compliance Delivery • Vendor & Third-Party Management • Agile / Waterfall / SDLC

PROJECT MANAGER | WIPRO LIMITED Jan 2026 – Present Lloyds Bank – Payments Domain

Leading payment-related initiatives across the European region covering ISO 20022 MX messaging, Instant and Classic Payments, ACH, SWIFT, payment gateways, platforms and digital payment journeys. • Lead end-to-end payment project delivery covering scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, resource planning, risk assessment and delivery

controls.

Drive ISO 20022 initiatives covering PACS, PAIN and CAMT messages within EPC guidelines, with focus on compliant and secure payment delivery. • Establish project governance frameworks, roles, decision-making structures and controls; monitor risk, compliance, performance and stakeholder alignment.

Manage project budgets and cost tracking; prepare project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, business cases, SOWs and high-level

estimates.

Lead payments delivery across payment gateways, payment processors, merchant onboarding, Instant and Classic Payments, including authorization,

clearing, settlement and reconciliation flows.

Engage business, technology, IT, compliance, finance, operations, architects, financial institutions and executive leadership; conduct status meetings,

steering committees and executive updates.

Maintain RAID logs and mitigation plans; coordinate audits, certifications and regulatory submissions. • Manage payment gateway, core banking and fraud-solution vendors and third parties; support regulatory requirements including PCI-DSS and AML/KYC. Nordea Bank – Payments Domain Led payment initiatives across Finland, Norway, Denmark and Sweden, with primary focus on SEPA enhancement, compliance and ISO 20022 migration. • Led SEPA payment enhancement, compliance and migration initiatives into ISO 20022 MX messages including PACS, PAIN and CAMT under

SEPA/EPC/NPC guidelines.

Owned end-to-end delivery of payment technology and strategic initiatives, ensuring delivery within agreed scope, time and budget. • Established governance frameworks, roles, decision-making structures and project controls; managed status, requirements, feasibility and risk assessments.

Developed and implemented payment risk-management strategies covering fraud, compliance issues and technology failures; maintained mitigation

plans.

Led cross-functional teams across IT, finance, operations and compliance, coordinating developers, UX/UI, compliance teams, financial institutions

and executive stakeholders.

Maintained project plans, status reports, risk registers and lessons learned; provided regular progress, issue and risk updates to senior management. • Oversaw UAT and testing phases for payment systems and coordinated stakeholder feedback through implementation. • Managed regulatory alignment across SEPA/EPC/NPC requirements and other relevant payment standards and regulatory considerations.

PROJECT MANAGER & BUSINESS ANALYST | LTIMINDTREE Apr 2022 – Nov 2022 HSBC Bank – Seeburger Payments Transformation

Payment transformation programme integrating Seeburger as a global platform for HSBC payment applications. • Led payment transformation and legacy migration from Heritage Connect to Seeburger Digital Connect, including cloud migration, API enablement and

partner/customer onboarding.

• Managed integration across APIs, HSBC Net File Upload, Sterling File Gateway and SWIFT channels. • Worked with stakeholders on ISO 20022, SWIFT, cross-border payments, Direct Debit, ACH and Wire Transfer initiatives. • Managed full SDLC delivery and supported solution vision, objectives, requirements, quality, time and cost controls.

• Analyzed legacy issues and implemented improvements to strengthen API support and reduce customer onboarding time.

PROJECT MANAGER & BUSINESS ANALYST | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Jun 2018 – Mar 2022 Citibank – GPPSP Payments Domain

Supported a global integrated payments solution for Citibank customers, with focus on cross-border, instant and high-value payments. • Worked on payment transformation across Cross-Border, Instant and High Value Payments modules. • Managed and monitored cross-border payment requirements and developed process flows for Instant Payments, High Value Payments, Cross-Border

Payments and Wires.

Coordinated with Operations, Technology and Business teams; conducted walkthroughs and maintained client-approved payment documentation. • Used JIRA and Confluence for requirements and project documentation; held regular progress calls, identified risks and tracked delivery quality.

BUSINESS ANALYST | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Sep 2017 – Jun 2018 Access Management

Business analysis and application support for the RIGHTS access-management solution. • Managed application requirements, customer issues, demonstrations, training and service objectives.

SOFTWARE QA TEST LEAD | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Nov 2015 – Sep 2017 Citibank – Payments Domain

QA leadership for ALTO/Flexcube payment systems. • Led test planning, execution and defect management for payment transactions and system analysis; mentored testers and maintained quality

documentation.

Improved QA testing efficiency by 20% and built a defect database supporting consistency and compliance.

TEAM LEAD & SME | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) May 2014 – Nov 2015 Prospect Mortgage – US Mortgage Underwriting

Operational leadership, performance tracking, risk assessment and status reporting.

OPERATIONS MANAGER & SME | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Apr 2012 – May 2014 Citibank – US Mortgage Pre-Foreclosure

Process re-engineering, risk monitoring, audit/RCSA support and team leadership.

TEAM LEAD & SME | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Sep 2010 – Apr 2012 Citibank – Global Cards Payments / Retail Operations

Project coordination, training, prioritization, staff management and on-time delivery.

EXECUTIVE & SME | TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES (TCS) Feb 2008 – Sep 2010 Citibank – Global Cards Payments / Retail Operations

Global card settlement and payment programme operations with compliance and operational controls.

EDUCATION

Masters of Management Studies (PGDBA – Finance), NMIMS, 2011 – Distinction • Master of Commerce (M.Com – Accounts), M.M.K College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai University, 2008 • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com – Accounts), M.M.K College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai University, 2006 CERTIFICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL TRAINING

ISTQB Certified (2017) • Project Management / PMP-PMI training • Change Management training • Lean Project Management • Lean Six Sigma Introduction • Agile Foundations / PMBOK Seventh Edition / Transformational Leadership training SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

Awarded BPS Star Performer Certificate (2016). • Employee of the Year recognition (2010) and appointment as Audit/InfoSec Coordinator. • Best Icon recognition from Head – Global Cards Operations (2008 & 2009). • Absolute Zero Defects recognition for project quality (2008 and 2009).
